hints.title: Diagonal Candidate Pairs
hints.text: For two points to form opposite diagonal corners of an axis-aligned rectangle, their coordinates must differ on both axes.

hints.title: Corner Verification
hints.text: Check that the two remaining corresponding corners exist in the set of given points.

hints.title: Empty Boundary and Interior
hints.text: Iterate through all points and verify that no other point falls within the bounding box inclusive of borders.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Diagonal point enumeration verifies existence of opposite corners and empty interior/boundary.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing all point combinations is only feasible for small n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) hash set for coordinate lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Validates four corners and ensures no point lies on border or interior.
